findings.message: Track 1 has 14 timed elements in this HTML file. Smaller sub-compositions keep timelines easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Move coherent scene groups into separate .html files under compositions/ and mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so the timeline stays easier to inspect, revise, and validate.

findings.message: Frame 0 shows only the background, and the first frame is the thumbnail on social players: have the title or key image already on screen at 0 s instead of entering from nothing; see references/review.md.

"One post for the whole calendar" (6 words) is on screen 1.53 s (±0.01 s), under its 1.72 s floor: hold it about 0.5 s + 0.3 s a word (2.30 s here) before it leaves or changes; see references/motion.md.

findings.message: Type floor is 28 px (2.6% of the 1080 px short side, what a phone can read) and 14 text elements stay under it for 0.5 s or more, the smallest "NEW" at 22 px: set reading text to at least 28 px, or put data-layout-ignore on text that is texture rather than reading; see references/look.md.
